4. Field Insights
Key themes observed during field interactions this period include growing interest in the mRNA platform's potential beyond infectious disease, persistent questions around myocarditis risk in younger males, and increasing KOL engagement with mRNA-4157 data. Market access barriers related to booster hesitancy were noted in several regions.
5. Next Steps
Schedule follow-up meeting with Thomas Roberts, MD to discuss updated clinical data
Submit unsolicited inquiry responses through Medical Information portal
Attend regional infectious disease conference to identify new KOLs
